arxiv-2012-11785.title: Classification and a priori estimates for the singular prescribing Q Q -curvature equation on 4-manifold
arxiv-2012-11785.creator: Mohameden Ahmedou, Lina Wu, Lei Zhang
arxiv-2012-11785.description: Abstract . On ( M , g ) (M,g) a compact riemannian 4 − 4- manifold we consider the prescribed Q − Q- curvature equation defined on M M with finite singular sources. We first prove a classification theorem for singular Liouville equations defined on ℝ 4 \mathbb{R}^{4} and perform a concentration compactness analysis.

arxiv-2110-01215.title: Intermediate planar algebra revisited, II
arxiv-2110-01215.creator: Keshab Chandra Bakshi, Sruthymurali
arxiv-2110-01215.description: Abstract . We describe the subfactor planar algebra of an intermediate subfactor N ⊂ Q ⊂ M N\subset Q\subset M of an extremal subfactor N ⊂ M N\subset M of finite Jones index which is not necessarily irreducible. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 46L37 1.

arxiv-2206-05763.title: SeATrans: Learning Segmentation-Assisted diagnosis model via Transformer
arxiv-2206-05763.creator: Junde Wu, Huihui Fang, Fangxin Shang, Dalu Yang, Zhaowei Wang, Jing Gao, Yehui Yang, Yanwu Xu (✉)
arxiv-2206-05763.description: Abstract Clinically, the accurate annotation of lesions/tissues can significantly facilitate the disease diagnosis. For example, the segmentation of optic disc/cup (OD/OC) on fundus image would facilitate the glaucoma diagnosis, the segmentation of skin lesions on dermoscopic images is helpful to the melanoma diagnosis, etc.

arxiv-2302-01670.title: The liberation set in the inverse eigenvalue problem of a graph
arxiv-2302-01670.creator: Jephian C.-H. Lin, Polona Oblak, Helena Šmigoc
arxiv-2302-01670.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jephian C.-H. Lin, Polona Oblak, Helena Šmigoc. The inverse eigenvalue problem of a graph G G is the problem of characterizing all lists of eigenvalues of real symmetric matrices whose off-diagonal pattern is prescribed by the adjacencies of G G . The strong spectral property is a powerful tool in this problem, which identifies matrices whose entries can be perturbed while controlling the pattern and preserving the eigenvalues. The Matrix Liberation Lemma introduced by Barrett et al.

arxiv-2309-14114.title: Hybrid Strangeon Stars
arxiv-2309-14114.creator: Chen Zhang, Yong Gao, Cheng-Jun Xia, Renxin Xu
arxiv-2309-14114.description: Abstract It was conjectured that the basic units of the ground state of bulk strong matter may be strange-clusters called strangeons, and they can form self-bound strangeon stars that are highly compact. Strangeon stars can develop a strange quark matter (SQM) core at high densities, particularly in the color-flavor-locking phase, yielding a branch of hybrid strangeon stars.

arxiv-2502-08226.title: TRISHUL: Towards Region Identification and Screen Hierarchy Understanding for Large VLM based GUI Agents
arxiv-2502-08226.creator: Kunal Singh, Shreyas Singh, Mukund Khanna
arxiv-2502-08226.description: Abstract Recent advancements in Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) have led to the emergence of LVLM-based Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents developed under various paradigms. Training-based approaches, such as CogAgent and SeeClick, suffer from poor cross-dataset and cross-platform generalization due to their reliance on dataset-specific training.

britannica-1911-mcdowell-irvin.title: McDowell, Irvin (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-mcdowell-irvin.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-mcdowell-irvin.description: Article 'McDowell, Irvin' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. born in Columbus, Ohio, on the 15th of October 1818. He was educated in France, and graduated at the U. military academy in 1838. From 1841 to 1845 he was instructor, and later adjutant, at West Point. He won the brevet of captain in the Mexican War, at the battle of Buena Vista, and served as adjutant-general, chiefly at Washington, until 1861, being promoted major in 1856.

pmc-10534795.title: Extracellular Vesicles in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Progress and Challenges in the Translation from the Laboratory to Clinic
pmc-10534795.creator: Rong Yan, Haiming Chen, Florin M. Selaru
pmc-10534795.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Extracellular vesicles (EVs) play critical roles in intercellular communication by transporting bioactive cargo to recipient cells. EVs have been implicated in a range of physiological and pathological processes, including tumor progression, metastasis, immune modulation, and drug resistance. The objective of this review is to present a thorough overview of recent studies focusing on EVs in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), with an emphasis on their potential utility as diagnostic biomarkers as well as therapeutic agents.

pmc-11509790.title: Based on Sportomics: Comparison of Physiological Status of Collegiate Sprinters in Different Pre-Competition Preparation Periods
pmc-11509790.creator: Pengyu Fu, Xiaomin Duan, Yuting Zhang, Xiangya Dou, Lijing Gong, Cholsoon Jang, Vassilis Mougios
pmc-11509790.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study aimed to assess the impact of pre-competition training by comparing the differences of collegiate sprinters in physiological state between strengthening and tapering training period by sportomics and combining their sport performance.

pmc-11580568.title: Atrial fibrillation and prediabetes: Interplay between left atrium and systemic diseases
pmc-11580568.creator: Ming-Jui Hung
pmc-11580568.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Atrial fibrillation (AF) is associated with multiple other comorbidities, i.e. Prediabetes is one of the multiple comorbidities observed in patients with AF, whereby these two disease entities share the same pathophysiological mechanisms, namely oxidative stress and inflammation. Although prediabetes is reported to have a negative impact on major adverse cardiac or cerebrovascular events in hospitalized AF patients, information about the interactions between prediabetes and AF remains inconsistent.

pmc-11585839.title: Macrophages on the run: Exercise balances macrophage polarization for improved health
pmc-11585839.creator: Yotam Voskoboynik, Andrew D. McCulloch, Debashis Sahoo
pmc-11585839.description: ObjectiveExercise plays a crucial role in maintaining and improving human health. However, the precise molecular mechanisms that govern the body’s response to exercise or/compared to periods of inactivity remain elusive. Current evidence appears to suggest that exercise exerts a seemingly dual influence on macrophage polarization states, inducing both pro-immune response M1 activation and cell-repair-focused M2 activation.

pmc-13171971.title: Morphological character evolution and ancestral state reconstruction in phylactolaemate bryozoans
pmc-13171971.creator: Julian Bibermair, Ahmed J. Saadi, Thomas Schwaha
pmc-13171971.description: Phylactolaemates represent a small clade within bryozoans that exclusively occur in limnic habitats. About 100 species are described in seven to eight families. Since they are sister taxon to the extensive clade of myolaemate bryozoans, understanding their evolution is crucial for all bryozoans.

pmc-13181073.title: Orthogonal recognition of miRNA and lncRNA enables high-fidelity cancer diagnostics
pmc-13181073.creator: Yiqun Guo, Jingkun Zhang, Liangyu Jiang, Huamei Yin, Xiankai Niu, Liang Shen, Yuna Guo, Yuancheng Li
pmc-13181073.description: Recent advances in molecular diagnostics have highlighted the transformative potential of multi-protein response logic gates in enhancing sensitivity and specificity for cancer detection. However, logic gates based on multi-type nucleic acid responses remain underexplored. In this study, we present a dual-biomarker response platform that utilizes nucleic acid logic gates targeting miR-21 (microRNA-21) and lncRNA MALAT1 (metastasis-associated lung adenocarcinoma transcript 1).

pmc-13336994.title: Gut microbiota influences gastric cancer through the mediation of inflammatory proteins: A Mendelian randomization analysis
pmc-13336994.creator: Chenyang Yu, Fule Wang, Xinfang Zhang, Wenzhao Guo, Changchuan Bai, Guanhua Lv
pmc-13336994.description: A robust correlation exists between gastric cancer (GC) and intestinal flora, potentially facilitated by inflammatory proteins. Nevertheless, the precise relationship between GC, intestinal flora, and their respective mediators remains unclear. The objective of this study is to employ a Mendelian randomization (MR) study to determine the cause-and-effect link between GC, inflammatory proteins, and gut microbiota.

pmc-13519803.title: First Report of a Carbapenem-Resistant Comamonas resistens Strain Co-Carrying blaIMP-8 and Two Putative Rare β-Lactamase Genes, blaCAE-1 and blaPAU-1, in China
pmc-13519803.creator: Yizhang Wang, Meifang Zeng, Yunfeng Gu
pmc-13519803.description: BackgroundCarbapenems are among the last-line antibiotics for treating severe Gram-negative infections. Comamonas spp. are increasingly recognized for their clinical pathogenicity; however, carbapenem-resistant isolates have rarely been documented.MethodsSpecies identification was confirmed by MALDI-TOF MS and whole-genome sequencing. Antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) was determined via Vitek 2 Compact.

pmc-13546810.title: Berberine‐Pretreated Bone Marrow Mesenchymal Stem Cells Accelerate Skin Wound Healing in Rats With Burn Injuries
pmc-13546810.creator: Jinglei Tan, Caiqiang Chen
pmc-13546810.description: Berberine (BBR) is a natural isoquinoline alkaloid with antibacterial, anti‐inflammatory and pro‐angiogenic properties. This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic efficacy and underlying mechanism of a conditioned medium (CM) derived from berberine‐preconditioned bone marrow‐derived mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs‐BBR). BMSCs were isolated and phenotypically characterised by flow cytometry.
